description: Simply Better Suite is a complete collection of Minecraft Fabric 1.21.1 mods inspired by the legendary EssentialsX plugin.It rebuilds and modernizes the classic server features that defined the best multiplayer experiences over the years.Each module is independent yet fully connected through Simply Better Core, wich handles conf, DB  etc

mods.name: simplyBetterWarps
mods.description:
Adds a complete warp management system that lets players and administrators create, delete, edit, and teleport to named warp points.
It also provides advanced permission-based visibility and access control, allowing you to define exactly who can see or teleport to each specific warp.
All data is synchronized through the Core’s database and API to ensure consistency across the suite
